project.name: backend-server
project.description: Vertical slice: the native install's server settings (specs/012-server-program) - the setting catalog, the .env document (comments kept), validation and probes, history and conflicts, who may change settings, and restart requests to the supervisor. Hexagonal internally (domain/application/adapter packages under com.fathy.alfred.backend.server). A leaf slice: other slices are reached only through backend-app/serverbridge, which implements this slice's out-ports (LiveSettingsPort, StorageUsagePort, TrafficRatePort). ServerConfigCli (adapter.in.cli) runs the same service without Spring for the alfred config command line.
